description: Search Polymarket and Kalshi prediction markets by text in the question (or by exact market id / Kalshi ticker): returns up to 20 markets with platform, id, question, category, end date, status, URL and closed_time (when the market closed before the data cutoff). Filter by platform and status (open, closed, resolved, any). Set resolved_before_cutoff: true to list only resolved markets with enough data for prediction_market_pre_resolution. Use it to find the market id needed by the other prediction_* tools. Data is delayed by at least 24 hours (independently recorded from the public Polymarket and Kalshi APIs; not affiliated). Free: no wallet or payment needed.

limit.description: Number of results: integer from 1 to 20. Default: 20.

platform.description: Platform: polymarket or kalshi (lower case). Default: both platforms.

q.description: Text to look for: case-insensitive substring of the market question, or an exact market id / Kalshi ticker (listed first). Max 100 characters. Default: empty = the most recently recorded markets.

resolved_before_cutoff.description: true: only markets resolved before the data cutoff AND with at least 3 price points in the 24 h before the resolution, i.e. actually purchasable on /v1/markets/{id}/pre-resolution (overrides status). false: no filter. Default: false. Results carry closed_time whenever it is known before the cutoff.

status.description: Market status as of the data cutoff: open, closed, resolved or any. Default: any.

name: prediction_search_markets
title: Search Polymarket and Kalshi markets
